**What happened?**
Tell me what you did, what you expected, and what you saw. Something like
"I tapped the garage door on my lock screen and Home said No Response" is
perfect.

**The report**
In Garage Agent on the Android phone, tap **Share report**, choose
**Copy**, and paste it between the lines below. It has no passwords and no
setup code in it.

```
paste the report here
```
